note: NOT refuted: 4 members x 4 probes x 30 runs, all distinct=1. Value is in the control: 2 of 4 probes were inert until the unpatched build exposed them.

controls.name: unpatched-control-fires
controls.must_fire_because: distinct=1 is also what an INERT probe returns; only reverting the patches separates "stable" from "measuring nothing"
controls.can_fail_because: it DID fail: 2 of the 4 probes scored distinct=1 on the UNPATCHED build and were rewritten before their PASS meant anything
controls.null_must_contain: every probe must show distinct>1 on a build with the patches reverted

controls.name: patched-differs-from-unpatched
controls.must_fire_because: the probe must separate the two builds by VALUE, not only by stability
controls.can_fail_because: if the fix did not change the printed output the probe would pass on both builds and prove nothing
controls.null_must_contain: the patched sample and the unpatched sample must not be the same string

controls.name: all-four-members-covered
controls.must_fire_because: host-min has a different feature set and the phone a different ISA and OS; a host-only check speaks for neither
controls.can_fail_because: if two workers resolved to the same binary the observations would be constant and certify refuses

falsifier: all four quorum-member binaries carry the nondeterminism patches live -- every probe returns a single stable result on every binary
